class.name: mapping_rviz_panel/MappingPanel
class.description: One button per mapping step (LiDAR, LIO-SAM, low level, GPS, NTRIP) and one that saves the map with /lio_sam/save_map. Each step runs in its own terminal window; its state comes from the process table. Open it with mapping_panel.launch.py to get LIO-SAM's displays and the golf cart model in the same window.
